s.how: Cut a cucumber, 2 carrots and a red capsicum into sharp triangles like teeth, with 200g sugar snap peas. Blitz 200g sour cream with parsley, lemon and a garlic clove. Fish are friends, not food.

s.note: the colours of the Great Barrier Reef
s.how: Spread 8 slices fresh white bread with soft butter right to the edges. Press face down into hundreds and thousands. Cut into little fish with a cutter and serve straight away.

m.note: a Sydney lunch, no fish allowed
m.how: Marinate 4 chicken thighs for an hour in lemon juice, 2 crushed garlic cloves and oregano. Grill until charred and cooked through. Build on toasted buns with sliced avocado, beetroot, lettuce and a good spoon of aioli.

w.note: orange and white stripes, like Nemo
w.how: Mix 400ml fresh orange juice with 2 tbsp honey. Freeze a layer in moulds for 40 minutes, then a layer of 200g vanilla yoghurt, then orange again. Add sticks after the second layer. Freeze 6 hours.

d.how: Fill four glasses with crushed ice. Pour in 150ml pineapple juice and 100ml coconut water each, then add a splash of blue raspberry cordial. Garnish with a pineapple wedge.
